Add expiry to our LRU cache in `lib/cache.js`.

- `new LruCache({ max, ttlMs })`: optional `ttlMs` is the default time-to-live of every entry, in milliseconds. Without it, entries never expire (as now).
- `cache.set(key, value, { ttlMs })` overrides the TTL for that one entry. Setting an existing key again restarts its TTL.
- An entry whose age is greater than or equal to its TTL is expired: `get` returns `undefined` (and counts as a miss in `stats()`), `has` returns `false`, and it is not counted by `size`, not listed by `keys()`, and is removed when found.
- New method `prune()` removes all expired entries and returns how many it removed.
- Reading an entry with `get` updates its LRU position but does not extend its TTL.
- Time comes from the `now` option (a function returning milliseconds), which already exists for tests; it defaults to `Date.now`.

No npm packages; `node --test test/` runs the existing tests.
